question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Union Executive?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 52 to 78**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• **President's Office & Powers (Articles 52-53):** Establishes the office of the President and outlines executive powers.
 
• **Election & Term of President (Articles 54-56)**: Describes the process of electing the President and the term duration.
 
• **Impeachment Procedure** **(Article 61):** Details the procedure for impeaching the President.
 
• **Vice President's Office & Role (Articles 63-64)**: Establishes the office of the Vice President and role as Chairman of Rajya Sabha.
 
• **Council of Ministers & Prime Minister** **(Articles 74-78)**: The President acts on the advice of the Council, with roles of ministers and duties of the PM.
